title: 8 倒计时08
content_zh:
游决在秋夜里赶来，身上还带着丝丝冷气，衣服上的天竺葵香味也格外冷冽。
倪夏连忙说：“我家没有男式拖鞋，就这么进来吧，明早阿姨会来打扫卫生。”
她看着游决的背影，嘴角的笑压了又压，没压住，最后用婉转到有些做作的音调问道：“你怎么来了呀？”
游决做事的时候习惯只穿单衣，便顺手脱下外套挂在玄关的挂衣区，“太晚了，她一个女生也不安全。”
客厅的装潢风格也能看出其时代特色，好在实木家具虽不潮流，倒也不会有过气感。
而且老式大平层总是不吝于展示面积，连通的客餐厅逼近百平，层高过三米，更显得房子足够华贵。
除去那些一看就是剧组所需的物料和文件外，桌上、柜子里竟堆满了专业书籍。
游决粗粗扫了一眼，流体力学、材料科学等专业书随处可见，电视墙下的层板间隙也塞满了与之相关的核心工程与技术科学类书籍。
游决抬眼，整个客餐厅里，但凡无遮挡的墙面上，都占满了奇思妙想的绘画。
有的只是随意张贴的分镜素描，有的精心上色并装裱，挂在显眼的地方。
隔着好几米远，游决看不清是水彩还是油画，只见画中的双马尾女孩驾驶着锈迹斑斑的改装潜水艇，四周鲨鱼环伺，五彩珊瑚张牙舞爪，但水波的刻画足以表达这艘潜水艇正在全力冲刺，毫不减速。
自游决接手这个案子，还没有时间去看看《贝莉的海底世界》这本书到底讲了个什么故事。
在这静谧得几乎只能听见呼吸声的客厅里，倪夏见游决盯着那幅画看了很久，心里的小得意按捺不住。
就在倪夏思考他是否在回答她的问题时，游决突然问道：“就你一个人？”
倪夏愣了一下，说道，“不是，还有一个制片人，她有事不在江城。”
接触过影视行业的人都知道，即便是小项目，整个剧组也动辄一两百人。
content_en:
You Jue came in the autumn night, still carrying the slightest bit of air-conditioning on his body, and the scent of geranium on his clothes was particularly cold.
Ni Xia quickly said: "I don't have men's slippers at home, so just come in. Auntie will come to clean tomorrow morning."
She looked at You Jue's back, the smile on her lips suppressed and suppressed, and finally asked in a tactful and somewhat artificial tone: "Why are you here?"
You Jue was used to wearing only single clothes when working, so he took off his coat and hung it in the hanging area in the entrance. "It's too late, she's not safe as a girl."
The decoration style of the living room can also reflect the characteristics of the times. Fortunately, although the solid wood furniture is not trendy, it does not feel outdated.
Moreover, the old-fashioned large flat floor always spares no effort in display area. The connected living room and dining room are close to 100 square meters, and the floor height is more than three meters, which makes the house even more luxurious.
Except for the materials and documents that looked like they were needed by the crew, the desks and cabinets were filled with professional books.
You Jue took a cursory glance and saw that professional books such as fluid mechanics and materials science could be found everywhere. The gaps between the shelves under the TV wall were also filled with related core engineering and technical science books.
You Jue raised his eyes and saw that all the unobstructed walls in the entire living room and dining room were covered with whimsical paintings.
Some are just storyboard sketches posted casually, while others are carefully colored and framed and hung in conspicuous places.
Several meters away, You Jue couldn't tell whether it was a watercolor or an oil painting. All he could see in the painting was a girl with twin ponytails driving a rusty modified submarine, surrounded by sharks and colorful corals, but the depiction of the water waves was enough to show that the submarine was sprinting at full speed without slowing down.
Since I took over this case, I haven't had time to read the story of "Bailey's Underwater World".
In the living room, which was so quiet that the only sound of breathing could be heard, Ni Xia couldn't help feeling proud when she saw You Jue staring at the painting for a long time.
Just when Ni Xia was thinking about whether he was answering her question, You Jue suddenly asked: "Are you alone?"
Ni Xia was stunned for a moment and said, "No, there is another producer. She is not in Jiangcheng because of something."
Anyone who has been in contact with the film and television industry knows that even for a small project, the entire crew often has one or two hundred people.
